newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli shekel weakens against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Israeli shekel weakens against dollar.

text.p: The Israeli shekel weakened slightly against the dollar on Monday in thin trading, dealers said.
"Trading continues to be very quiet and I believe that in the near term the dollar will continue to trade at 3.5 to 3.6 shekels," said a dealer at United Mizrahi Bank.
"Volume is very low but investors are less nervous and spreads in interbank trading have narrowed to only 50-60 points from 100-150 last week," she said.

The representative rate for the dollar was fixed at 3.5580 shekels against 3.5520 on Friday. The basket, composed of the dollar, mark, pound sterling, French franc and yen, was fixed at 3.8414 against 3.8554 on Friday.
On the crosses, the shekel traded against the yen at 3.1226 shekels per 100 yen compared with 3.1240 on Friday, and against the mark at 1.9862 shekels compared with 2.0235 on Friday.
In late afternoon, the dollar was trading at 3.5580 shekels.
- Dan Gerstenfeld, Tel Aviv newsroom, 972-3-537-2211 x233
